acceptanceCriteria: Recovery accepts explicit governance work_item_id or contract_path and an optional explicit source_work_item_id or source_contract_path in one request.
Missing, partial, or mismatched source binding fails closed in the cheap release_input_preflight stage before the Rust build.
Source-quality planning and gate use the source Contract base, path, and digest; release/public acceptance retains the governance Work Item identity.
Normal tag release and standalone public acceptance behavior remain unchanged.
Regression tests cover dual identity, default same-identity behavior, missing source, mismatched source, and downstream dependency gating.
goal: Separate the release governance Work Item identity from the source-verification Work Item identity so immutable-tag recovery can validate current orchestration changes without widening the published Release acceptance Contract.
intent: Make recovery source validation and release acceptance bindings explicit and independently verifiable while preserving fail-closed scope and immutable artifact boundaries.
outOfScope: crates/**;Runtime lifecycle semantics;tag or Release mutation;published assets;public acceptance scripts;object repositories;main-push routing;historical records;global configuration

scenarioCoverage.expected: A recovery request can bind governance/release identity and source-verification identity independently.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run resolver fixture and hosted workflow policy tests with distinct governance and source Work Items; verify both identities and source baseline are emitted.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A technical retry with no source selector defaults source verification to the governance identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run resolver regression fixture without source selector and assert source fields equal governance fields.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Unknown or partial source identity is rejected in release_input_preflight before the Rust build.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run resolver cases for missing source ID/path and mismatched ID/path; assert nonzero structured diagnostic and policy assertions for cheap-stage gating.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Source quality validates changed paths against the source Contract while release acceptance remains bound to the governance Contract.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect workflow route construction and gate arguments; run static policy tests and a fixture with distinct Contract bases.

scenarioCoverage.expected: When cheap input preflight fails, build, publish, public acceptance, and close do not act as if inputs exist.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run release workflow policy regression and inspect dependency conditions for skipped downstream jobs and structured close reporting.
